title: Ada and the Orbit
author: Jonah Lockridge
blurb: Xanthe Thackeray, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
